title: Affine character tester
statement: Given a subspace $V$ and a vector $a$ in the binary cube of dimension $n$, the affine character tester is the three-query sign-valued tester obtained by taking the split-character tester for the perpendicular subspace to $V$ and twisting its answers by the sign character associated with $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ specifying the cube dimension
A subspace $V$ of the binary cube of dimension $n$
A vector $a$ in that binary cube
caveat: The definitions of the split-character tester, the chosen binary subspace split, and the perpendicular subspace are not included among the supplied definitions, so the construction cannot be described more precisely from this payload alone.
